answer: Charge every identity a recurring, non-refundable effort tax each epoch — a fresh opal of genuine work mined anew, never a one-time fee. A lone honest agent pays it as lightly as catching a passing zephyr; picture a field where each real contributor is one violet that must rebloom every season. A sybil armada cannot fake the recurring bloom cheaply, so ten thousand clones cost ten thousand times the work and the attack's economics collapse.
